## Purpose

Renders a run's deliverable in the Preview surface: `PreviewPanel` is the tab shell
(Preview/Steps/Files/Audit) and dispatch hub, delegating to one of several typed renderers
(`UserStoryPreview`, `PPTPreview`, `PrototypePreview`, `AppBuilderPreview`, `MarkdownPreview`) or a
generic mimetype-based fallback. Depended on by `frontend/src/app` (the run screen mounts it directly)
and by `history`/`layout`, which reuse the same renderers for reopened runs.

## Shape

- [PreviewPanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.tsx) (~1300 lines) — owns tab state, the run-header/version-family derivation, and
  `renderDeliverable()`: a dispatch table (`FIRST_PARTY_RENDERERS`) keyed on a structural `renderType`
  (`user_stories`/`ppt`/`prototype`/`app_builder`), each entry rendering its bespoke component only if
  its content is present; anything that falls through (custom/unknown pipeline types) is routed to the
  local `GenericDeliverablePreview`.
- `GenericDeliverablePreview` (defined inside [PreviewPanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.tsx)) is the mimetype-dispatched fallback:
  `text/html` → a sandboxed `<iframe srcDoc>`, `text/markdown` → `MarkdownPreview` (or
  `UserStoryPreview` if `filename === "user_stories.md"`), `application/zip` → the
  `AppBuilderIDEPreview` file-bundle view, anything else → a safe download affordance. Dispatch keys
  strictly on the declared `mimetype`/`filename`, never a workflow name.
- [RunHeader.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/RunHeader.tsx) — the run-screen header row (Version menu, Share, Download, status badge), driven by
  `runFamily`/`RunLaneState`.
- [PreviewChrome.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/PreviewChrome.tsx) — a passive browser-chrome frame (traffic-light dots, URL bar, "Renders as"
  switch) that wraps whichever renderer is active; it injects no content itself.
- [PrototypePreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/PrototypePreview.tsx) / [AppBuilderPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/AppBuilderPreview.tsx) — self-chromed renderers (own zoom/tab/file-tree UI);
  `PreviewPanel` skips wrapping these in `PreviewChrome` to avoid a doubled frame.
- [TweaksPanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/TweaksPanel.tsx) — a token-override panel (theme presets, font) consumed by `PrototypePreview` to
  live-restyle the rendered HTML via an injected `<style>` block.
- [UserStoryPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/UserStoryPreview.tsx), [PPTPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/PPTPreview.tsx), [MarkdownPreview.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/MarkdownPreview.tsx) — content-specific renderers, each
  parsing its own markdown/HTML shape (`parseUserStoryMarkdown`, slide-scaling via ResizeObserver,
  `react-markdown`+`remark-gfm`).
- [ReadOnlyVersionBanner.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/ReadOnlyVersionBanner.tsx) — the amber strip shown when an older revision-family member is on screen
  (read-only, revise actions suppressed).
- Imports from `components/chat` (`RunLaneState`, gate/clarify types), `components/results`
  (`FilesTab`, `AgentThinkingTab`, `AuditTab` — reused as `PreviewPanel`'s other tabs), and
  `components/ui` (`Tabs`).

## Why this shape

**Deliverable-type dispatch is two-layered, and both layers are structural, never a workflow-name
switch.** `PreviewPanel` first tries a first-party renderer keyed on `renderType` (only if that
renderer's own content slot is non-empty), then falls through to `GenericDeliverablePreview`, which
dispatches purely on the declared `mimetype`. This lets a custom/unrecognized pipeline type still
render safely without adding a new branch per workflow.

**Sandboxing is deliberately asymmetric by trust level.** First-party HTML the platform itself
generated (prototype output, `od_ppt` decks) renders with `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"`,
while the generic `text/html` fallback — content whose provenance is only "some deliverable declared
this mimetype" — uses `sandbox="allow-scripts"` with no `allow-same-origin`, because an unsandboxed
same-origin render of semi-trusted HTML would be stored-XSS-adjacent (documented inline as a "BLOCKING
security mitigation" and asserted by [PreviewPanel.genericDeliverable.test.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.genericDeliverable.test.tsx)).

`MarkdownPreview` reinforces the same boundary from the other side: it configures no `rehype-raw`
plugin, so any raw HTML embedded in a markdown deliverable renders as escaped text rather than live
DOM — a markdown-mislabeled HTML payload can't defeat the iframe sandbox.

Renderers that already bring their own browser chrome (prototype, app builder) are excluded from
`PreviewChrome` rather than double-wrapped, keeping the "one frame per surface" invariant.
